en.headline: eHealth registration reaches 87 per cent of Hong Kong population
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said more than 6.5 million residents have joined the electronic health system as it marks its tenth anniversary.
body: More than 6.5 million Hong Kong residents, or 87 per cent of the population, have registered for the Electronic Health System (eHealth), Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Saturday.

Speaking at a tenth-anniversary event, Lo said the platform now connects over 4,700 public and private healthcare organisations and more than 63,000 healthcare providers. Monthly usage has exceeded 1.3 million logins and the mobile app has been downloaded more than 4.3 million times.

He called on remaining residents to register and noted that private-sector data uploads had more than doubled over the past year. New functions under the eHealth+ plan include cross-boundary health records and electronic consent forms for seasonal vaccinations.

zh.headline: 醫健通登記人數突破650萬 佔全港人口87%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂在十周年活動上表示，系統已連結逾4700間醫護機構及6.3萬名醫護人員。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周六表示，醫健通登記人數已突破650萬，佔全港人口87%。
他在十周年慶祝活動上指出，平台現已連結超過4700間公私營醫護機構及逾6.3萬名醫護專業人員，流動應用程式下載量超過430萬次，過去三個月月均登入次數突破130萬。
盧寵茂呼籲未登記市民盡快登記，並指過去一年私營醫護上傳病歷數據按年增加逾一倍。醫健通+計劃已推出跨境健康紀錄及電子同意書等新功能。
